name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.

files.content:
Single

data-np-calendar on an empty element. Arrow keys move, PageUp and PageDown change month, Shift for years.

Multiple

data-mode="multiple", data-attribute form, no classes.

Range

data-mode="range" with data-months="2".

Month and year selector

data-caption-layout="dropdown".

Presets

Buttons with data-np-calendar-set and data-target.

Booked dates

data-disabled-dates and data-booked-dates.

Cell size and notes

--np-calendar-cell-size and data-day-note-*.

Week numbers

data-show-week-number.

Date and time

The calendar next to other fields.

In a form

data-name adds a hidden input with the ISO date.

Value: -

Event

A np-calendar-change event fires on every change.

Pick a range.
